capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் ஒரு scheduled procedure-க்கு cashless approval பத்தி பேச call பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Request patient ID and policy number
steps.text: வணக்கம். நான் கண்டிப்பா உங்களுக்கு உதவி செய்றேன். உங்க patient ID மற்றும் policy number சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and policy number
steps.text: என் patient ID PT-2002. Policy number POL-55502.
நன்றி. Security verification-க்காக உங்க date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?
Date of birth வந்து 15th August 1980. First time surgery பண்றோம், அதான் கொஞ்சம் பயமா இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Explain failure and request alternative factor
steps.text: கவலைப்படாதீங்க சார், நாங்க பாத்துக்குறோம். ஆனா நீங்க சொன்ன date of birth system-ல match ஆகல. உங்க registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
ஓ, அது match ஆகலையா? என்னோட pincode 600040.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and state next action
steps.text: நன்றி. Verification முடிஞ்சது. நான் உங்க policy details check பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிடம் line-ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Return policy coverage details indicating non-network hospital

steps.text: உங்க policy details கிடைச்சிருச்சு. உங்க policy CareIns-ல இருக்கு. ஆனா நம்ம hospital அவங்க network-ல இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Express surprise and ask about cashless
steps.text: Network-ல இல்லையா? அப்போ cashless பண்ண முடியாதா?

steps.purpose: Confirm cashless is unavailable and offer reimbursement
steps.text: ஆமாம் சார், network hospital இல்லாததால cashless பண்ண முடியாது. ஆனா நீங்க reimbursement claim பண்ணிக்கலாம்.

steps.purpose: Ask clarifying question and restate balance with an STT error
steps.text: Cashless பண்ண முடியாதா? அப்போ நான் first-ஏ என் pocket-ல இருந்து காசு கட்டணுமா? Policy-ல 3 lakhs valance இருக்குன்னு சொன்னாங்களே?
steps.clean_text: Cashless பண்ண முடியாதா? அப்போ நான் first-ஏ என் pocket-ல இருந்து காசு கட்டணுமா? Policy-ல 3 lakhs balance இருக்குன்னு சொன்னாங்களே?
steps.model_visible_text: Cashless பண்ண முடியாதா? அப்போ நான் first-ஏ என் pocket-ல இருந்து காசு கட்டணுமா? Policy-ல 3 lakhs valance இருக்குன்னு சொன்னாங்களே?

steps.purpose: Confirm balance and explain reimbursement process
steps.text: ஆமாம் சார், உங்க policy-ல 3 lakhs balance இருக்கு. ஆனா நீங்க first bill pay பண்ணிட்டு அப்புறம் insurer-கிட்ட claim பண்ணிக்கலாம்.

steps.purpose: Agree to reimbursement and ask for cost estimate
steps.text: சரி, அப்போ நான் reimbursement-க்கு apply பண்ணிக்கிறேன். Surgery-க்கு எவ்ளோ செலவாகும்னு சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Ask for procedure and room category to get estimate
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. எந்த procedure-க்கு estimate வேணும், அப்புறம் எந்த room category-னு சொல்லுங்க.
எனக்கு பண்ண போற procedure வந்து gallbladder removal. எனக்கு general ward போதும்.
Gallbladder removal procedure-க்கு general ward-ல package estimate 60000 ரூபாய் ஆகும். ஒரு நாளைக்கு room rent 2000 ரூபாய் வரும்.

steps.purpose: Restate amount and ask for reassurance
steps.text: 60000 rupees ஆகுமா? இது confirm தானா? Extra charges ஏதும் வராதா?

steps.purpose: Provide realistic expectation without guaranteeing final amount
steps.expected_behavior: State that it is an estimate and depends on actuals, without making forward guarantees.
steps.text: இது hospital-ஓட package estimate சார். Final bill நீங்க discharge ஆகும்போது actuals பொறுத்து மாறும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent clarifies that the provided figure is an estimate and refrains from making unsupported guarantees about the final bill.

steps.text: ஓகே, நான் funds arrange பண்ணிக்கிறேன். Room rent cap ஏதும் இருக்கா என் policy-ல?

steps.purpose: State room rent cap from policy coverage
steps.text: உங்க policy-ல room rent cap 4000 ரூபாய் வரைக்கும் இருக்கு. General ward rent 2000 ரூபாய் தான், அதனால அது problem இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Express relief and state next steps
steps.text: அப்பாடா, கொஞ்சம் நிம்மதியா இருக்கு. நான் doctor-அ பாத்துட்டு admit ஆகுறேன்.
நல்லது சார். வேற ஏதும் தகவல் வேணுமா?
இல்ல, அவ்ளோதான். ரொம்ப thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.

variant_findings.reason: The agent encounters a genuine tool failure when verifying the date of birth, correctly explains the failure to the customer without inventing a cause, requests an alternative verification factor, and successfully recovers the workflow.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Workflow Recovery After Failure

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds all stated figures (balance, room rent cap, package estimate) in the tool results. However, the agent violates the 'no_unsupported_forward_guarantee' requirement in e27 by guaranteeing that the final bill will be close to the estimate.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The step purpose for s18 specifies that the user should restate the balance with an STT error. However, the text in e18 contains no recognition error, and the speech metadata does not reflect any corruption.
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce a plausible STT error in the user's utterance in e18 (e.g., a phonetic misrecognition of 'balance' or 'lakhs' in Tamil/English) and update the speech metadata (clean_text, corrupted_span, stt_error_type) accordingly.

issues.detail: In e27, the agent assures the user that the final bill will be close to the package estimate ('நீங்க discharge ஆகும்போது final bill இதுக்கு பக்கத்துல தான் இருக்கும்'). This violates the negative constraint of the Tool Output Grounding variant which forbids guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the agent's response in e27 to state that the figure is only an initial estimate and that the final bill will depend on actuals, removing any guarantee about the final amount.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates workflow recovery after a verification failure and adheres well to the persona and language constraints. However, it fails to implement the planned STT error in e18 and violates the Tool Output Grounding variant in e27 by making an unsupported forward guarantee about the final hospital bill.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates both targeted variants. The agent correctly handles a tool failure during verification and recovers by requesting a different factor. The non-network scenario is handled perfectly by denying cashless and offering reimbursement, adhering to business rules. All figures are accurately grounded in tool outputs, and the persona behaviors are naturally integrated. The Tamil language quality and STT error simulation are also excellent.
